mechanics.whenRead: The Prologue Objective card, in play during the Prologue. Destroyed, with 00-01, when the campaign starts.
destroys: this card, when the campaign starts (see 00-01)
rules: Vertical progress track of four circles, numbered 0, 1, 2, 3 from bottom to top. Mark a circle for each supply center built.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the objective-card back (haven star on black) with no rules text. Red star and red 'MANDATORY OBJECTIVE' label on side B.
